keyEndpoints.purpose: THE ODDS FEED for this bookmaker. NSoft public distribution endpoint, no authentication. companyUuid 7afdd6f5-f954-43d6-b696-2e0dc0ae4ee2 is a public tenant identifier read from the brand's own page, not a credential. Measured 2026-09-27: 1287 events in a 3-day window; football is sportId 18 on this tenant (486 events with a complete 3-way result market, e.g. "Austria - Kosovo"). Response is {data:{events:{...}, _mapping:{...}}} — events is an OBJECT keyed by id and every field is a short key resolved through _mapping (the price is the "odd" field, markets live under the event's "markets" key). Query needs filter[from]/filter[to], timezone, language, shortProps=1, offerTemplate=WEB_OVERVIEW and dataFormat={"default":"array","events":"object","outcomes":"array"}.

THE ODDS FEED for this bookmaker. A "lobby container" is a curated bundle of events with their markets and prices. Verified containers carrying prematch football 1X2 include 4155, 4136, 4146, 4147, 4161, 4162, 4169, 4170, 4204, 4988, 5087, 5161, 5170. Shape: {events:{id:{sportId, homeTeam, awayTeam, startTime, live, markets:[{marketTemplateName, marketTitle, outcomes:[{name, odds}]}]}}}. The match RESULT market is the one whose outcome names are 1 / X / 2 — note that other three-way markets exist and are NOT 1X2 (e.g. "Golul (3)" is goals within 3 minutes). Prematch means live === false.

EGT Digital public sports API. Unauthenticated, but gated on client device headers: a bare request returns HTTP 488 {"Message":"Missing user device header!"}. The minimum that satisfies the gate is x-platform-device: desktop + x-platform-lang: ro + x-platform-tz: 180 — ordinary client locale headers. x-platform-hash is NOT verified server-side (junk and omission both return 200) and x-platform-exp is only a client clock, so this is a device-identification header, not a signature or a challenge. Returns the sport catalogue; football is sportId 1001. The per-brand subpath is PWRO.

keyEndpoints.note: Sport list. 30 sports. Needs no query.
Per-sport view. Yields the league list at view.matches[].children[].categoryRn. Football = 128-130 leagues.
Per-league view. Contests at view.matches[].contestGroups[].contests[] as _typ LobbyFixtureContest, with propositions[].options[].price.

Per-contest detail view (_typ GetContestPage). Returns the FULL market menu at contest.propositions[] as variants[][] — 25 propositions on a typical football fixture: total (6 lines), 1st_half_total, both_teams_to_score, double_chance, 2_way_handicap (13 lines), 3_way_handicap, draw_no_bet, correct score, and player props. The lobby view ships only the default 1x2 proposition, so this call is what puts Unibet into the totals/BTTS/handicap comparison at all.
DEAD. The bulk endpoint whose GetFixtureContestsRequest model carries from/size answers 503 on every request, including from the site itself. Do not build on it.

crawl.fullMenuNote: Crawling all 30 sports the feed offers yields 1563 events in ~28s.
crawl.fullMarkets: Opt-in per job (fullMarkets in config/scrapers.json). Costs one contest-page request per event; detailLimit caps it. Measured 2026-09-28 with detailLimit=400 on Football: 689 contests crawled, 380 expanded, 687 events published, 3306 markets (4.81 per event, up from 1.0). Resolved families: 687 MATCH_ODDS, 862 OVER_UNDER/fulltime, 501 OVER_UNDER/half1, 556 ASIAN_HANDICAP, 346 BTTS, 350 DOUBLE_CHANCE; 4 unresolved of 3306.

requiredHeaders.note: The load balancer answers 400 InvalidRequestException without these. They are the names the site's own getBFFClient sends — plain, not the X-Brand / X-Locale pair used by the separate betting client, which is rejected here.

recovery.previousConclusion: Retired. Prices had moved to wss://sportsbff-ams.kindredext.net/betting-mqtt-sports/, which would have required an MQTT client.
recovery.correction: Wrong. That conclusion came from a 404 on a dead Kambi path plus a 400 on the live BFF that was really a missing-tenant-header rejection. The prices were always pollable REST. No MQTT client was ever needed.
how: www.unibet.ro/betting/odds is the sportsbook route; the site shell at /kwp-config and the SystemJS import map in its HTML name the sports API SDK.
The SDK takes its base URL from a constructor argument, so the path has to be recovered from the caller, not the SDK.
The caller is getBFFClient in ksp-shared-components, which also names the four tenant headers.
az-menu and views/lobby then return 200 with events.
